name: Same-observable degeneracy attack
authority_note: DSIR main later advanced to 328f2ca80b724870b851c7fe6366cce1ca5086cd; W02 evidence remains pinned to its starting authority and is not silently rebased.

edges.minimum_common_information: second pinned same-convention high-k suppression mechanism required
common scalar temporal centroid z_R exists but is insufficient for hard mechanism discrimination

central_result: Pairwise discrimination is graph- and channel-dependent. Restricted-block similarity, missing comparator implementations, and lossy scalar summaries are distinct failure modes. No W02 theory-space edge is promoted to observational discrimination without a pinned operator/covariance.
methodology_deltas: Never infer uniqueness from missing comparator implementation.
Keep theory-space and observation-space comparator graphs separate.
A portable characteristic scalar can still be too lossy; retain full temporal profiles when nearest alternatives are close.
Nearest-comparator testing must use the smallest sufficient common block, not the smallest convenient summary.
next_wave: W03 expanded dark-energy family and adversarial temporal/scale-response testing
